Why, Professor, it seems you give off a light of your own!

August 1st is my wife @bmmbooshoot's birthday! This is her original character, Tychon Whitfrost, from her original story, Golden Verse. Tychon was given the nickname "Sunflower" years ago, so I thought it would be cute to have one peeking through the window of his study!

Happy Birthday, Sadie!!" - Artist (Aug 1st, 2023)
